name: status-band
description: One plain line above the prompt: context, 5h and weekly limits, live new-token rate, cache countdown and advisor calls; open it for details.

showContext.title: Context gauge
showContext.description: Show the context window gauge on the band.

show5h.title: 5-hour limit gauge
show5h.description: Show the 5-hour limit gauge on the band.

showWeek.title: Weekly limit gauge
showWeek.description: Show the weekly limit gauge on the band.

showAdvisor.title: Advisor
showAdvisor.description: Show the advisor count, the 'Advisor consulted' note and the Advisor section in the details.

showCache.title: Cache countdown
showCache.description: Show the prompt-cache countdown on the right of the band.

showCost.title: Cost
showCost.description: Show the session cost (≈ $) on the band and in the details.

showRate.title: Live token rate
showRate.description: While Claude works, show the new-token rate on the right. Off shows the cache countdown instead.

showAlerts.title: Warnings
showAlerts.description: Let the band warn about a full context, a limit running out or a cache about to expire.

detailsNow.title: Details: right now
detailsNow.description: Show the Right now section (live rate, last 15 minutes, this turn) when the details are open.

detailsLimits.title: Details: limits
detailsLimits.description: Show the Limits section when the details are open.

detailsCache.title: Details: cache
detailsCache.description: Show the Cache section when the details are open.

detailsSession.title: Details: this session
detailsSession.description: Show the This session section (tokens, re-reads, cost) when the details are open.

advisorFlashSeconds.title: Advisor note seconds
advisorFlashSeconds.description: How long the band says 'Advisor consulted' after a call. 0 turns the note off.
